title: Benchmark report artifact
description: Every benchmark run must produce an artifact matching this schema. Numbers are machine-written by the bench harness only — never hand-typed (see CONTRIBUTING.md #6).

timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp the run completed, ISO 8601.

git_sha.description: Exact commit the benchmarked code was built from.

limitations.description: What this run did NOT exercise, machine-written from the observed fleet (ADR-013). Required so a reader taking only the JSON cannot mistake a partial validation for a complete one.

load_term_differentiable.description: False when all agents shared one physical host, where host-wide psutil/NVML readings make every node's reported load identical by construction — so the alpha*L term of S_i was untested.

latency_term_differentiable.description: False when all agents dialed loopback, so measured RTT differs only by noise and the gamma*D term of S_i was untested.

provisional.description: Present and true only when the run came from a dirty worktree, meaning git_sha does not fully describe the code that ran.
